segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good morning, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: A bit sore, sir. My knee is painful, but I expected that.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Understood. Can you rate your pain for me? Out of 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Maybe 3 or 4 lah. It’s manageable, but I can feel it throbbing.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Okay, and are you feeling nauseous or have vomited at all?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: No nausea, thank goodness. My tummy’s fine.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Good. How’s your breathing? Any shortness of breath or throat discomfort?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Breathing’s okay, but my throat’s a bit sore from the tube, I think.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: That’s common after general anesthesia. Do you remember anything about the surgery itself?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Not really. I went to sleep and woke up here. All a bit fuzzy.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: That’s normal. Since you have allergic rhinitis, are you having any stuffiness or allergy symptoms now?

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Nasal’s a bit blocked, but not too bad. Like usual lah.

segments.speaker: PROVIDER
segments.text: Alright, we’ll keep an eye on that. Let the nurse know if you need anything for pain or discomfort.

segments.speaker: PATIENT
segments.text: Will do, doctor. Thanks for checking on me.
